prompt: Host this project on llocal. Follow https://llocal.app/agent.md step by step.
fix_prompt: My app on llocal didn't go live (app_id {app_id}). Call deployment_status for it and follow step 7 of https://llocal.app/agent.md.

tools.name: Claude Code
tools.text: claude mcp add --transport http llocal https://llocal.app/mcp; claude mcp login llocal; claude "Host this project on llocal. Follow https://llocal.app/agent.md step by step."
tools.note: Paste it in a terminal, in your project's folder. Your browser opens to sign in to llocal. If you can't sign in yet, your agent still starts and does what it can on your computer.

tools.name: Codex
tools.text: codex mcp add llocal --url https://llocal.app/mcp; codex mcp login llocal; codex "Host this project on llocal. Follow https://llocal.app/agent.md step by step."
tools.note: Paste it in a terminal, in your project's folder. Your browser opens to sign in to llocal. If you can't sign in yet, your agent still starts and does what it can on your computer.

tools.name: Cursor
tools.then: Host this project on llocal. Follow https://llocal.app/agent.md step by step.
tools.note: Open the link to add llocal to Cursor, then paste the sentence into Cursor's agent chat. Cursor asks you to sign in to llocal the first time.

tools.name: VS Code
tools.then: Host this project on llocal. Follow https://llocal.app/agent.md step by step.
tools.note: Open the link to add llocal, then paste the sentence into Copilot Chat in agent mode. VS Code asks you to sign in to llocal.

tools.name: Windsurf
tools.text: devin mcp add -s user llocal https://llocal.app/mcp; devin "Host this project on llocal. Follow https://llocal.app/agent.md step by step."
tools.note: Windsurf is now Devin Desktop. Paste it in a terminal, in your project's folder.

tools.name: Gemini CLI
tools.text: gemini mcp add --scope user --transport http llocal https://llocal.app/mcp; gemini -i "Host this project on llocal. Follow https://llocal.app/agent.md step by step."
tools.note: Paste it in a terminal, in your project's folder. If it says llocal needs signing in, type /mcp auth llocal.

tools.name: Cline
tools.text: cline mcp add llocal https://llocal.app/mcp --transport http --yes; cline --auto-approve false "Host this project on llocal. Follow https://llocal.app/agent.md step by step."
tools.note: Paste it in a terminal, in your project's folder.

tools.name: Zed
tools.note: Add it to Zed's settings.json, then ask Zed's agent to host the project on llocal.

tools.name: Claude
tools.text: In Claude, open Customize, then Connectors, then Add custom connector. Name it llocal, give it https://llocal.app/mcp, and press Connect.
tools.note: For checking on your apps and sharing them. To upload a project, use an agent that works in its folder, like Claude Code.

tools.name: ChatGPT
tools.text: On chatgpt.com, open Plugins, then + and Add custom MCP server. Give it https://llocal.app/mcp with OAuth, and install it.
tools.note: For checking on your apps and sharing them. To upload a project, use an agent that works in its folder, like Codex.

tools.name: Another tool
tools.text: Add a remote MCP server at https://llocal.app/mcp. It signs you in to llocal in your browser.
tools.note: A tool that can't sign in in the browser takes a token instead: make one on your llocal profile page and send it as the header Authorization: Bearer <token>.

packages.name: Claude Code plugin
packages.text: claude plugin marketplace add llocal-app/kit && claude plugin install llocal@llocal
packages.note: From the kit's public repository, github.com/llocal-app/kit.

packages.name: Cursor rule
packages.note: Save it as .cursor/rules/llocal.mdc in a converted project.

packages.name: AGENTS.md
packages.note: Add it to the project's AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md, for Codex and other tools.
